name: Treasury account add
description: Brings an account under the treasury on a payment rail, with a spend limit of nothing until the owner sets one. The rail checks the account and names its currency. For Convex: network, peer, address (#n), credential (the s/ name of its signing key) and custody (the DID of the user whose secret store holds it).

id.description: The account's id in the treasury: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens

rail.description: The rail the account is on, e.g. convex

output.description: The account as the treasury keeps it, with its limit, committed (what its budgets hold) and drawn.
